summary: No, the model is not beating the closing line: placed bets average -0.73% CLV on 66 closes (Backtester's Nov 17 cut: -1.9% on 54), and the prop model side is worse at -4.0% on 539 lines, beating the close only 7.6% of the time. The record is 86 bets, 27-57-2, -$145.49 on $491.32 staked (-29.6% ROI) with equity at $46.35, and per the Strategist nearly all of the loss is matchup_under (46 bets, -$96.65, -2.96% CLV on 28 closes), now paused. The Strategist's week of calls pointed the right way: since it first asked to trim prop volume on Nov 18 (34 bets, -$46.65), matchup_under lost another $50 over 12 more bets, and the model's log-loss still trails the market in every stat. Both shadow agents' held bets lost every time (Newsroom 0-1, Skeptic 0-4, $25 saved combined), a good early sign but far short of the ~150 graded calls needed (25 each). Most important: keep matchup_under and value_dog paused and lower prop volume and prop model weight until the prop side's CLV turns positive.
